description: Merge the contents of a source Obsidian vault into a target vault (defaulting to TDMCP_VAULT_PATH). Walks Recipes/, Shaders/, Presets/, Components/, Setlists/, and Memory/ folders. sha256-hashes each file pair and resolves conflicts with your chosen strategy: 'theirs' overwrites target, 'ours' keeps target, 'rename' writes a side-by-side copy, 'skip' logs and skips. dryRun=true plans without writing. Note: LF/CRLF differences count as conflicts.

sourceVaultPath.description: Absolute path to the source vault.

name: merge_vaults
title: Merge Vaults
